page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz, configured with 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of dedicated system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate average single-core capabilities but limited multi-core scaling. The single-core stress-ng and Geekbench scores fall into the average tier, supported by hardware-accelerated instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptography extensions like AES and SHA_NI. However, multi-core performance in stress-ng and Geekbench is poor, reflecting the physical single-core limitation. Memory bandwidth tests also show poor throughput, with large-block read and write speeds measuring 15.1 GB/sec and 13.63 GB/sec respectively.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance offers a dedicated CPU allocation for entry-level workloads without the performance variability of burstable instances, though its resource density is modest. It is best suited for lightweight general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, single-threaded applications, and small-scale development or testing environments that do not require high memory bandwidth or intensive multi-threaded processing.
